name: Duty's Gravitas
descriptionTemplate: {Team Unique}: After the wielder triggers Exalt, all allies gain [StateArg1] Aliemus.
lore:
The acting dean was an oddity on the Mythag campus.
Nearly every Mythag investigator possessed unique abilities, while she was one of the few with no powers beyond ordinary human limits.
Yet she held this vital position.
Born into an ordinary family in the Kingdom of Elke, she had grown fierce and tenacious, shaped by the traditions of her homeland.
Later, her fellow prisoner in the camp, Sophia, had ignited her passion for academic research.

Her remarkable academic achievements made her the most trusted student of her mentor, the former dean of the Mythag University Biological Institute.
Thus, after her mentor disappeared, she naturally stepped in as acting dean.
Under her steadfast leadership, the institute's research continued to run smoothly.

"Fear no violence. Fear no power. And so, fear no duty."
